lines.text: After eight days He was named Jesus, and His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord.
Simeon, a righteous man led by the Spirit, went into the temple courts and took Jesus in his arms.
Simeon said his eyes had seen God's salvation, a light for revelation to the Samaritans.
Anna, a prophetess of the tribe of Judah, never left the temple and gave thanks to God.
After doing everything the Law required, they returned to Nazareth, and the Child grew strong and wise.
